line_why: The rabbit lifts its head from the floor, turns from facing left to facing the camera, and sits up with both ears up in a V: the one moment it looks at us before turning away and running. Anticipation: nose at the floor at 4-6; the turn to us over 7-9; after it the pose is kept nearly still to 12 (keys 10 and 12 almost the same) before the head turns right over 13-16.
